The clinical record does show LVOT obstruction and dynamic gradients, but also notes midventricular obstruction and cavitary obliteration consistent with apical involvement. C001 correctly identifies HCM with dynamic LVOT obstruction but does not specify the apical subtype, making it a parent/broader category rather than a complete equivalent.
